content_sections.heading: About IIM Kozhikode
content_sections.text: Indian Institute of Management Kozhikode is located at IIM Kozhikode Campus P.O., Kunnamangalam, Kozhikode 673570. The notice describes the post's unit, the India-Japan Centre on Climate and Culture (IJCCC), as part of IIMK's aim of "globalizing Indian thought". The centre does this by combining climate, culture and international collaboration in one framework. The institute's phone number is 0495 2809160//366.

content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Research Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: Assist in data collection, processing and analysis. Develop and maintain software tools as required for the project. Conduct literature reviews and compile reports. Support the research team in documentation and presentation of findings. FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? content_sections.heading: IIM Kozhikode Research Assistant Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The maximum age is 35 years, counted on the date of the notification. The notification is dated 28 October 2026. M.Sc. in Computer Science/ MCA from a recognized university/ Institution. Check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions for the post.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Skill Test/ Interview. IIMK will screen the eligible applications, and only shortlisted candidates will be called for the skill test or interview. Time slots will be sent by e-mail. If the interview schedule changes, applicants will hear about it through the institute website or by email, so check both regularly. The Director, IIMK, has the final say on selection.

rows.date: Sent by e-mail to shortlisted candidates

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The post is purely on a contract basis for an initial six months. Any extension will depend on the project's requirements and the selected candidate's performance. All certificates and experience will be verified at the time of joining. The engagement depends on this verification. Canvassing in any form, or bringing in any influence, political or otherwise, will automatically disqualify a candidate.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Kozhikode Research Assistant Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Go to the IIM Kozhikode website at https://iimk.ac.in/ . You can only apply online. Fill in the online application for the Research Assistant post under Notification No. C-84/2026-IIMK.HR. Upload your photograph, certificates, CV and signature in the format the online portal sets. Submit the application by 5:00 p.m. on 17 November 2026. After you apply, keep checking the website and your email for shortlisting news and interview time slots. Documents to upload: photograph, certificates, CV and signature.

faq.question: Q1. Which centre at IIM Kozhikode is hiring the Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The India-Japan Centre on Climate and Culture (IJCCC). The centre works on climate, culture and international collaboration.

faq.question: Q2. Which degrees qualify for this post?
faq.answer: An M.Sc. in Computer Science or an MCA from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q3. On what date is age calculated?
faq.answer: Age is calculated on the date of the notification, which is 28 October 2026. The upper limit is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is the Rs. 25,000 salary paid with separate allowances?
faq.answer: No. Rs. 25,000/- is a consolidated monthly amount.

faq.question: Q5. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: The first contract is for six months. Any extension depends on project requirements and your performance.

faq.question: Q6. What does the job involve?
faq.answer: You will collect, process and analyse data, build and maintain software tools for the project, review literature, compile reports, and help the team document and present its findings.

faq.question: Q7. What do I need to upload with the online form?
faq.answer: Your photograph, certificates, CV and signature, in the format the online portal prescribes.

faq.question: Q8. How will shortlisted candidates find out about the skill test or interview?
faq.answer: Time slots will be sent by e-mail. Changes to the interview schedule will be posted on the IIMK website or emailed to you.

faq.question: Q9. What time is the deadline on the last day?
faq.answer: Applications close at 5:00 p.m. on 17 November 2026.
